proposal.summary: Unquoted service path for GameSDK Service (GameSDK.exe) allows a local attacker who can write to certain filesystem locations to get a service to execute an attacker-controlled binary when the service starts.

AV.quote: If an attacker had already compromised the system and the current user has the privileges to write in the "C:\Program Files (x86)\ASUS\" folder or in "C:\" , he could place his own "Program.exe" or "GameSDK.exe" files respectively, and when the service starts, it would launch the malicious file, rather than the original "GameSDK.exe".

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the service binary path and deploy the vendor-updated patched version (1.0.5.0). As a mitigation, quote the service path or move binaries to paths without spaces and restrict write permissions to the Program Files locations. Re-audit other services for unquoted paths.
